name: What are the signs I need a bathtub replacement?

mainEntity.name: What are the signs I need a bathtub replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs that indicate a bathtub replacement might be necessary include persistent cracks, leaks, or extensive chipping that compromises the tub's integrity. Stains that won't clean, significant mold or mildew issues, or a dull, worn-out appearance can also suggest it's time for an upgrade. Beyond aesthetics, if your tub is uncomfortable, difficult to access, or no longer meets your needs, a replacement can improve safety and functionality in your bathroom. Addressing these issues promptly can prevent further damage to your bathroom and enhance your bathing experience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs include cracks, leaks, persistent stains, mold, or an outdated appearance. A replacement can improve safety and functionality.
